UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and translation preferences stored privately per user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: User display name shown in the signed-in banner.

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In (owner-only PII).

preferredTargetLang.description: Preferred target language code (e.g. tr, en, de).

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the project owner.

packageName.description: Android package name parsed from AndroidManifest.xml.

inputSha256.description: 64-character SHA-256 hex digest of the unmodified input APK.

sourceLang.description: Detected or selected source language code.

translationEngine.description: Translation engine mode used for this project.

aiSecuritySummary.description: Gemini AI-generated APK security and resource analysis summary.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the APK project.
